ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: According to the given food chain, which organism would suffer most if there were no water beetles?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a food chain/food web. At the bottom is Algae (algae), and arrows point from Algae to Tadpole (tadpole), Water Beetle (water beetle), and Snail (snail). An arrow points from Tadpole to Small fish (small fish), and from Small fish to Kingfisher (kingfisher). An arrow points from Water Beetle to Frog (frog), from Snail to Frog, and additionally from Frog to Kingfisher. Reasoning: In a food chain, arrows usually indicate that energy flows from the organism being eaten to the organism that eats it, that is, the arrow points from the food/prey to the predator. The question asks which organism is most affected if there are no water beetles. In the image, the one that directly depends on Water Beetle as food is Frog, because there is an arrow from Water Beetle to Frog. Therefore the organism most affected is frog.
